items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: He was a real good musician, but I guess liquor took all of him, like Fazolo. Yeah. But he was a fine musician. Fazolo liked to drink, huh? Yeah, he did drink a lot, too.

ctx.x: Yeah. Cause all of his family, you know, tried to play the clarinet act, and there was a few

lay-ons there, I believe a couple of, you know, about three lay-ons there. And they all tried to, I mean, you know, they thought they could, it was, it felt like, a great rap, but it was impossible. And what about, there was a fan, too, he died, I think. Yeah, well, he was real good. He was a real good musician, but I guess liquor took all of him, like Fazolo. Yeah. But he was a fine musician. Fazolo liked to drink, huh? Yeah, he did drink a lot, too. He used to drink, gee, with, you see, gin with beer chasers…
